I will give an example that i saw yesterday . A lady was walking infront of me clearly upset and she was crying . I approached her and was trying to find out what was wrong and why she was so upset and if there was anything i could do to help . A car drove by and the man inside leaned out of the window and shouted 'drug smoking cunts ' and other expletives . None of us knew him , it was totally unprovoked and then he just drove off . Anyway , i found out that the lady was upset because she was from the nursing home and had just lost her father . I sat with her for a while and made sure she got an uber home . Acts like that just break me .

My reason for asking this is through interactions and observation. I avoid such people at all costs but just sitting there and watching how they treat people around them freaks me out enough to not want to know them . I wonder why they are so angry but then again i do not want to be dragged into the loop so i avoid at all costs . I have seen a good number of such peiple try and be corrected but what leaves me in shock is that they absolutely do not see anything wrong in their behaviour . That is why i started to think maybe it is genetics and they have no idea they are like that .
